SELECT a.id AS "id", a.person_name AS "personName", a.month AS "month", a.classes AS "classes", a.id_card AS "idCard", a.employee_id AS "employeeId", jso.office_name AS "organization", pa.position_name AS "workshop", pl.prod_line_name AS "process", wg.work_group_name AS "workGroupName", a.create_by AS "createBy", a.create_date AS "createDate", a.update_by AS "updateBy", a.update_date AS "updateDate", a.remarks AS "remarks", a.status AS "status" FROM swm_person_schedule a left join swm_person sp on a.id_card = sp.identity_card LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive pa ON sp.department = pa.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line pl ON sp.prod_line = pl.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON sp.team = wg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN swm_work_type backup_wt ON sp.job_type = backup_wt.work_type_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN js_sys_office jso ON sp.company = jso.office_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
a.status = '0' and sp.status = '0'
AND a.person_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{personName}, '%')
AND a.month = #{month}
AND a.classes = #{classes}
AND a.id_card = #{idCard}
AND jso.office_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{organization}, '%')
AND pa.position_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{workshop}, '%')
AND pl.prod_line_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{process}, '%')
AND wg.work_group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{workGroupName}, '%')
ORDER BY a.update_date DESC
